en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate, high‑ceilinged dining or reception hall with long banquet tables laid with white tablecloths, chairs lined along both sides, elaborate chandeliers, large framed portraits on wood‑paneled walls, and decorative arches with balustrades above. Printed red text at the lower right identifies the location as an officers' casino (mess) of a field artillery regiment in Dresden, and smaller red text at bottom left credits the printer.
